label: first l/i/n/s/w/z among the first 4 inputs; plus the second copy step of length-3 sequences
explanation: Has two parts. (1) Original phase, positions 0-3 only (never at t>=4 in the original phase): it fires when the input is one of a preferred set of letters (l strongest at about 5.7x lift and 31% of mass, then i, n, s, w, with weaker z, c, g, 2), mostly on the first such token. A second preferred token after one has already fired is usually inactive. (2) Copy phase: the largest activations (up to max) are at t=4 of L=3 sequences (recall_idx 1, input = orig(0) fed back), and they fire for almost any token, strongest when that token is l. It is nearly silent on the delimiter and at copy steps past recall_idx 2. Token preference is graded rather than sharp, which caps precision and recall. Dev F1 0.72, mass recall 0.81.
